run.name: Carnival Corp Ltd.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CCL)
run.summary: Credit view is strong and improving but not yet earnings-led: net debt to EBITDA fell to 3.19x through debt repayment, with liquidity of USD 5,720 million, while EBITDA was flat and cash returns to shareholders are rising. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

revenue.basis: Total revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA (operating income + D&A, unadjusted), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Total debt 24,559 (Q3 10-Q page:9); cash 1,220 (Q3 10-Q page:2). LTM EBITDA is 7,273 plus nine months 2026 5,850 less nine months 2025 5,812 = 7,311 (Q3 10-Q page:2). Unadjusted. Fiscal 2025 comes from the joint report and 2026 from the single-company reports; the group consolidated is the same.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. EBITDA 7,273 (operating income plus depreciation and amortization, 10-K page:63) divided by cash paid for interest, net of capitalized interest, of 1.2 billion (10-K page:98). The cash interest figure is printed rounded to 0.1 billion, so the ratio lies between 5.82 and 6.32 if the true figure is between 1.15 billion and 1.25 billion.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash (Q3 10-Q page:2); revolver availability (Q3 10-Q page:10). Export credit undrawn of 10.7 billion excluded (Q3 10-Q page:10). Revolver matures June 2030, so no committed facility expires within twelve months. An accordion of up to 1.0 billion of additional commitments (10-K page:80) is uncommitted and excluded.

cashflow.basis: Cash from operations, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Indentures, covenant ratios, rating levels and fiscal 2025 adjusted EBITDA are not supplied, so legal ranking and covenant headroom cannot be assessed.
CP-1 main limitation: EBITDA is operating income plus depreciation and amortization; fiscal 2025 adjusted EBITDA and interim cash interest are not supplied.
